location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，204 教室

goal.en: Introduce yourself to the class and get to know a classmate.
goal.zh: 向全班自我介紹，並認識一位同學。

background: bright language school classroom with desks arranged in a circle, a clean whiteboard, large windows, potted plants on the windowsill, a bookshelf in the corner, morning sunlight

intro.en: Room 204. Twelve students from all over the world sit in a circle, looking a little nervous.
intro.zh: 204 教室。來自世界各地的十二位學生圍成一圈坐著，看起來都有點緊張。

intro.en: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ms. Reed. Let's get to know each other.
intro.zh: 大家早！我是瑞德老師。我們來互相認識一下吧。

lines.en: Let's start with you. Could you tell us a little about yourself?
lines.zh: 就從你開始吧。可以跟我們簡單介紹一下你自己嗎？

choices.en: Sure. My name is Kai, and I'm from Taiwan.
choices.tip: My name is... 加上 I'm from...，就是最清楚的開場自我介紹。

choices.en: OK. I am call Kai. I come from Taiwan.

lines.en: You're calling Kai? Is Kai coming to class too?
lines.zh: 你在打電話給凱？凱也要來上課嗎？

story.en: The whole class turns to the door, waiting for someone named Kai. It takes a while to sort it out.
story.zh: 全班都轉頭看向門口，等一個叫凱的人進來。好一陣子才把誤會解開。

fail.why: 「我叫 Kai」不是 I am call Kai，這樣聽起來像「我正在打電話」。直接說 My name is Kai. 或 I'm Kai. 就好。

choices.en: Me? Um, nothing special. Next person, please.
choices.zh: 我？呃，沒什麼特別的。下一位吧。

lines.en: Nothing special? Oh, come on. Everyone has a story!
lines.zh: 沒什麼特別的？別這樣嘛，每個人都有自己的故事！

story.en: Ms. Reed moves on to the next student. By Friday, nobody in class remembers your name.
story.zh: 瑞德老師只好換下一位。到了星期五，班上還是沒人記得你的名字。

fail.why: 台灣人習慣謙虛說「沒什麼特別的」，但在英語課堂上，老師請你自我介紹是真心想認識你。大方說 My name is Kai, and I'm from Taiwan. 就對了。

lines.en: Welcome, Kai! So, what are you into?
lines.zh: 歡迎你，凱！那你喜歡什麼呢？

choices.en: I'm really into hiking and taking photos.
choices.tip: I'm into + 名詞／V-ing，是口語的「我很喜歡、很著迷」，比 I like 更生動。

choices.en: I like playing computer very much.

lines.en: Playing the computer? Like a piano?
lines.zh: 彈奏電腦？像彈鋼琴那樣嗎？

story.en: A classmate asks if you can play a song on your laptop. The class waits for a concert that never comes.
story.zh: 有同學問你能不能用筆電彈一首歌。全班等著一場永遠不會開始的演奏會。

fail.why: 「玩電腦」直譯成 play computer，play 加樂器才是「演奏」，聽起來很怪。要說 play computer games，或 I'm into gaming.。

choices.en: I'm into to hike and take photo.

lines.en: Into to...? Sorry, could you try that again?
lines.zh: Into to……？抱歉，可以再說一次嗎？

story.en: You try again, and again. By the third time, even you are not sure what you like.
story.zh: 你試了一次又一次。到第三次，連你自己都不確定到底喜歡什麼了。

fail.why: I'm into 後面要接名詞或 V-ing，不能接 to + 動詞。正確說法是 I'm into hiking and taking photos.。

lines.en: Great! Now, turn to your partner and keep chatting.
lines.zh: 很好！現在轉向你的搭檔，繼續聊聊。

lines.en: Hi, I'm Yuki! So, what do you do in your free time?
lines.zh: 嗨，我是由紀！那你空閒時都做些什麼？

choices.en: In my free time, I usually watch movies.
choices.tip: In my free time, I + 頻率副詞 + 動詞，描述平常的習慣。usually、often、sometimes 放在動詞前面。

choices.en: I usually go to shopping in my free time.

lines.en: Go to Shopping? Is that a town near here?
lines.zh: 去 Shopping？那是附近的一個小鎮嗎？

story.en: Yuki looks up "Shopping" on her phone map. You both spend the break searching for a town that doesn't exist.
story.zh: 由紀打開手機地圖搜尋「Shopping」。你們整個下課都在找一個根本不存在的小鎮。

fail.why: shopping、swimming、hiking 這類活動前面直接用 go，不加 to。要說 I usually go shopping.。

choices.en: Free time? Yes, it's free. No money.
choices.zh: 空閒時間？對，免費的，不用錢。

lines.en: Um, free time, not free stuff. Like your hobbies?
lines.zh: 呃，是空閒時間，不是免費的東西啦。像是你的嗜好？

story.en: Yuki gives up and chats with the student on her other side. You spend the rest of the activity alone.
story.zh: 由紀放棄了，轉頭和另一邊的同學聊天。剩下的活動時間你都一個人度過。

fail.why: free time 是「空閒時間」，不是「免費的時間」。被問 What do you do in your free time? 要回答平常的休閒活動，例如 I usually watch movies.。

lines.en: Time's up! Kai, can you tell us one thing about Yuki?
lines.zh: 時間到！凱，可以跟大家說一件關於由紀的事嗎？

choices.en: Sure. Yuki is from Osaka. She loves baking.
choices.zh: 好的。由紀來自大阪，她很喜歡烘焙。
choices.tip: 介紹別人時，女生用 she，男生用 he。開口前先想一下，就不會說錯。

choices.en: Sure. Yuki is from Osaka. He loves baking.
choices.zh: 好的。由紀來自大阪，她很喜歡烘焙。

lines.en: He? Kai, I'm pretty sure I'm a she!
lines.zh: 他？凱，我很確定我是女生耶！

story.en: The class spends a whole minute figuring out who "he" is. Yuki takes it well, but Ms. Reed writes he and she on the board.
story.zh: 全班花了整整一分鐘搞清楚「他」是誰。由紀不太在意，但瑞德老師在白板上寫下了 he 和 she。

fail.why: 中文口語的「他」和「她」發音一樣，所以台灣人說英文時很容易把 he、she 混用。由紀是女生，要說 She loves baking.。

choices.en: Yuki? Sorry, I forgot. I wasn't listening.
choices.zh: 由紀？抱歉，我忘了，我剛剛沒在聽。

lines.en: You weren't listening? I talked for five minutes!
lines.zh: 你沒在聽？我講了五分鐘耶！

story.en: Yuki sits with someone else for the rest of the week. The seat next to you stays empty.
story.zh: 這週剩下的時間，由紀都坐到別人旁邊。你旁邊的座位一直空著。

fail.why: 直接說「我沒在聽」很傷人。就算真的忘了，也可以說 Sorry, could you remind me?，請對方再說一次。

lines.en: Thanks, Kai! You're a good listener.
lines.zh: 謝謝你，凱！你很會聽人說話。

lines.en: Wonderful! I can see this class is going to be fun.
lines.zh: 太好了！看來這個班會很有趣。

story.en: By the end of the first class, you know three new names and have one new friend. Not bad for day one.
story.zh: 第一堂課結束時，你記住了三個新名字，還交到一個新朋友。第一天表現不錯。

notes.en: My name is Kai, and I'm from Taiwan.
notes.explain: 自我介紹最基本的兩句。也可以簡單說 I'm Kai.，但不要說 I am call Kai.。

example.en: Hi, everyone. My name is Yuki, and I'm from Japan.
example.zh: 大家好，我叫由紀，來自日本。

notes.explain: I'm into + 名詞／V-ing，表示對某件事很有興趣、很著迷，比 I like 更口語。後面不接 to + 動詞。

example.en: I'm really into Korean dramas these days.

notes.en: In my free time, I usually...
notes.explain: 描述休閒活動的句型。頻率副詞 always、usually、often、sometimes、never 放在一般動詞前面。

example.en: In my free time, I often go hiking with friends.
example.zh: 空閒時我常和朋友去爬山。

notes.en: go shopping, not go to shopping
notes.explain: shopping、swimming、hiking 等活動前面直接用 go，不加 to。go to 後面接地點，例如 go to the mall。
在英語文化裡，被問到自己的事時過度謙虛（例如 Nothing special.）會讓對話中斷。分享一兩個興趣，別人才有話題接下去。

example.en: I'm from Taiwan, and I love night markets.
example.zh: 我來自台灣，我超愛夜市。
